first_cover.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing / historical-scene.
Create ONE finished Bilibili video cover for episode02 Cao Cao of the CK3 Mod《汉晋春秋》. Rework the attached episode01 cover into a matching episode02 cover. Deliver a single precisely16:9 landscape image, ideally1920x1080 pixels or2048x1152, edge-to-edge artwork, no border, no mockup or contact sheet.
Input image1: existing Dong Zhuo episode cover, a STYLE AND SERIES LAYOUT reference. Keep its excellent cinematic painterly realism, huge gold/ivory brush lettering, charcoal ink swashes, compact upper-left brand and powerful close-up portrait on the right. This is a NEW episode image; replace that subject and setting.
Input image2: actual episode02 gameplay frame, IDENTITY/ERA reference only: Cao Cao is the black-capped bearded man in the upper-left portrait, NOT the woman or other portraits. Do not reproduce the game UI or screenshot. Reimagine him as polished historical key art, age34–38, lean strong face, alert calculating eyes, black moustache and pointed black beard, simple close-fitting late Eastern Han black military cap, dark lamellar armor and deep crimson cloak. Make Cao Cao instantly readable and commanding, with controlled ambition rather than a grin. No imperial crown, ornate gold royal headdress or emperor throne. Do not keep Dong Zhuo's broad heavy face/body.
Backdrop: atmospheric late Han Chenliu city gate and walls at dusk, wind-swept red and dark military standards, distant understated army silhouettes, charcoal storm cloud with red-gold rim light and a few subtle embers suggesting the episode's inner wildfire. No burning Luoyang palace; no graphic violence or additional main characters. The city is not engulfed in flames. Face strongly lit and fully visible on the right, text against darker space on the left.
Text, exact simplified Chinese only, same bold brush style as image1:
Upper-left compact brand: “汉晋春秋”, beneath it small “CK3 MOD”, with a small clear “曹操篇” episode tag.
Title on left in these THREE readable lines, reading top to bottom as the exact approved title《帮过我的朋友，挡住了我的去路》:
“帮过我的朋友” (antique gold, slightly smaller to fit)
“挡住了” (large ivory)
“我的去路” (large ivory)
No extra slogan, labels, statistics or substitute title. Every glyph must be correct: 帮 过 我 的 朋 友 / 挡 住 了 / 我 的 去 路. Full title must remain visible. Let portrait and typography dominate at mobile thumbnail scale. Keep strong clean hierarchy and generous margins; reserve the bottom-right corner for the site's duration badge, no important text there. No platform logos, watermarks, fake game UI, next-episode tease or fantasy armor. Keep the same series identity as the first cover while clearly depicting Cao Cao and this episode.

second_cover.prompt:

Return ONE standalone finished image on a precisely4:3 landscape canvas, ideally1600x1200 pixels, NOT16:9 and not a montage.

Keep exactly the same lean Cao Cao face, eyes, black beard/moustache, black Han military cap, dark lamellar armor, crimson cloak and close-up portrait on the right. Brand “汉晋春秋”; small “CK3 MOD”; small red-seal episode tag “曹操篇”.
Title on the left, three lines exactly:
“帮过我的朋友” in antique gold, slightly smaller so all six glyphs fit
“挡住了” in large ivory brush lettering
“我的去路” in large ivory brush lettering
Together this is《帮过我的朋友，挡住了我的去路》. Do not omit or paraphrase any character, do not add a second title, extra slogans, numeric claims, or English title. Maintain at least5% safety margin for text and keep bottom-right free of important text for Bilibili's duration badge. Keep lettering fully separated from the face. No imperial crown, fantasy costume, platform logo, watermarks, fake UI, border or next-episode teaser. Deliver the actual4:3 cover only.
